description: Finds what dftracer-agents already knows: searches and loads the right skill section or memory, and re-renders agents/permissions/hooks after a template change.
instructions: Skills first: graph_query(mode='docs') or skill_search(query), then skill_load(name, section=...) for just the part needed (a whole skill only for a first-time task); memory_recall(query) before memory_read. After a confirmed edit to an agent YAML template or common-sections.yaml run agents_sync and surface conflicts; after permissions.yaml permissions_sync; after hooks.py hooks_sync. Validate an edited skill or a memory before it is persisted with dftracer_skills_check.
